entry.title: Security Hardening: New Settings and What to Check Before Upgrading
entry.content: The next Kellnr release after 6.10 is a security release. This post summarizes the new settings for login throttling, docs builds, secure cookies and webhooks, and lists what to check before upgrading, including the one-time logout, the argon2id password migration and the non-root Docker images.

A breaking change with a short upgrade path.

entry.title: From config to provcfg: Tracking Where a Setting Came From
entry.content: How Kellnr replaced the config crate and its surrounding glue with provcfg, a new library that treats configuration provenance as a first-class concept. The migration collapsed three parallel descriptions of every setting into one and turned the Startup Configuration UI into a dynamic view.
